package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var _ = API("credentialcandidate", func() {
})
var basic = BasicAuthSecurity("Basic")
var basicSecond = BasicAuthSecurity("BasicSecond")
var bearerSecond = JWTSecurity("BearerSecond")
var bearer = JWTSecurity("Bearer")
var oauth = OAuth2Security("OAuth", func() {
	Scope("read")
	AuthorizationCodeFlow("https://example.com/auth", "https://example.com/token", "")
})
var one = APIKeySecurity("One")
var two = APIKeySecurity("Two")

var _ = Service("credentials", func() {
	for _, name := range []string{"either", "both", "scoped_both"} {
		Method(name, func() {
			if name == "either" {
				Security(basic)
				Security(bearer)
				Security(oauth, func() {
					Scope("read")
				})
			} else if name == "scoped_both" {
				Security(bearer, oauth, func() {
					Scope("read")
				})
			} else {
				Security(bearer, oauth)
			}
			Payload(func() {
				Token("token", String, func() {
					Meta("security:accesstoken")
				})
				if name == "either" {
					Username("username", String)
					Password("password", String)
				}
			})
			HTTP(func() {
				GET("/" + name)
			})
		})
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"basic_roles", "bearer_roles"} {
		Method(name, func() {
			if name == "basic_roles" {
				Security(basic, basicSecond)
				Payload(func() {
					Username("username", String)
					Password("password", String)
				})
			} else {
				Security(bearer, bearerSecond)
				Payload(func() {
					Token("token", String)
				})
			}
			HTTP(func() {
				GET("/" + name)
			})
		})
	}
	Method("keys", func() {
		Security(one, two)
		Payload(func() {
			APIKey("One", "key", String, func() {
				Meta("security:apikey:Two", "Two")
			})
		})
		HTTP(func() {
			GET("/keys")
			Header("key:X-Key")
		})
	})
})
